entries.zh: 通过猜测/推想来查明；别出（另作别解、另出一说）
entries.en: to find out by conjecture; to infer/deduce
entries.notes: 西语 Aueriguar=Averiguar；'別出'直译'别出'，西语仅为 conjecturas，两栏侧重有偏差，中译偏推断义

entries.zh: 通过询问、奉命逐一查明而查明；别离、分别
entries.en: to ascertain by questioning/asking; separation, parting
entries.notes: 西语 aguirando 疑为 averiguando；汉栏'別離'与西语'查明'不对应，疑编纂错位，存疑

entries.zh: 仔细审问、详细盘问；详审
entries.en: to examine/interrogate in detail
to investigate in detail
to examine thoroughly, in full detail

entries.zh: 审查是与非、辨明真伪；审是非
entries.en: to examine whether it is true or false; ascertain the truth
to judge right and wrong, true and false

entries.zh: 核实、证实；填实（核实属实）
entries.en: to verify, establish the truth
entries.notes: '塡实'作为'查明真相'的汉语对应较间接，疑为'辨实/证实'之类；按汉栏直译

entries.en: to investigate by confrontation, face to face
entries.notes: 西语附 satisfacer/enplegencia 语义含混（疑 satisfied/en presencia），以汉栏'对面会'对质义为主

entries.en: to increase, augment; to add, expand
to report, inform (to a superior)
to petition/report to a mandarin
to report to a superior; to memorialize (the throne)

entries.zh: 上奏朝廷/皇帝的奏本；奏本
entries.en: a memorial to the emperor (in writing)

entries.zh: 奏请（皇帝）、上奏请求；奏请
entries.en: to petition the emperor, memorialize with a request

entries.zh: 奏请圣旨、请旨；奏圣旨（奏圣旨/奏圣主）
entries.en: to memorialize for an imperial edict/rescript
entries.notes: 汉栏'奏圣旨'末字存疑（[疑:聖/至]），按圣旨/请旨义处理

entries.en: to memorialize and make clear to the emperor

entries.zh: 劝诫、规谏、以纠正为目的的告诫；箴
entries.en: to admonish, correct by advice
to admonish and counsel (with rules of conduct)
to report, give news

entries.zh: 报喜、讨赏、报好消息；报喜
entries.en: to announce good news (and ask for a reward/tip)
to inform someone of something
